cross_horizon_alignment.note: Descriptive alignment only. Horizon disagreement is preserved and has no execution authority.

cycle_4_8w.summary: UNAVAILABLE cycle direction and UNAVAILABLE action posture: longer-window observations are ready, but no stable weekly phase or supported forward cycle path is established.

strategic_21_30d.expected_path: First assess whether BTC and ETH retain their late repair; then whether ETH/BTC and short-window participation improve persistently; finally assess longer-window breadth and settled flows. This is an ordered evidence test, not a scheduled cycle transition.
falsification: Sustained BTC and ETH resilience together with stronger ETH/BTC, broader persistent participation and improved settled flows would weaken the downside-sensitive base case.
Failure of the late repair alongside continued ETH-relative weakness, shrinking breadth and negative settled flows would weaken the mixed case toward contraction.
A single rebound or positive retained-exchange taker imbalance does not establish durable broad rotation.

scenarios.label: BASE
scenarios.thesis: Repair and retest attempts coexist; ETH-relative leadership and broad rotation remain unconfirmed.

scenarios.label: BULL
scenarios.thesis: Price resilience persists as ETH/BTC, broader participation and settled flows improve together.

scenarios.label: BEAR
scenarios.thesis: The repair fails while negative flows and weak relative participation persist.

strategic_21_30d.summary: The 21–30-day outlook is MIXED: BTC MIXED, ETH DOWN and ETH/BTC DOWN; WAIT posture, low confidence and a MIXED destination. Scenario weights are uncalibrated, not probabilities.

12h.path: Observed momentum only; no separately verified 12h forward forecast.

168h.path: MIXED with downside risk: the W43 rebound failed to hold, ETH weakened relative to BTC and short-window alt breadth deteriorated; positive BTC settled flows temper, but do not reverse, that evidence.

72h.path: Short-horizon state is cross-checked against the current weekly regime; transmission must improve before risk moves down-cap.
